concept: S3: SSE-KMS with customer managed key — audit and key access control
tests: Choosing S3 encryption with an audit of every key use and fine-grained decryption control, including cross-account.
expected: SSE-KMS with a customer managed key: every Decrypt is logged in CloudTrail, access is governed by the key policy (including cross-account). To save cost — S3 Bucket Keys. Triggers: "auditable trail of every key use", "who can decrypt", "cross-account".
why_not: SSE-S3 has no request-level audit and no per-key control; SSE-C passes keys in every request with no KMS audit; a hardcoded key is insecure.
